title: Interactive Demo
description: Try Qamposer in your browser. Drag gates onto the circuit and run simulations.

loading.title: Waking up the server...
loading.description: The demo server may take 30-60 seconds to start on first load due to cold start. It runs much faster once resources are allocated or when running locally.

backend.checking: Warming up the simulation server for "Set up and run" (may take 30-60s on first load). Ideal simulation already runs instantly in your browser.
backend.ready: Simulation server ready — "Set up and run" is available.
backend.error: The simulation server is unavailable right now. Ideal simulation still runs instantly in your browser; "Set up and run" may not work until the server is back.

error.title: Connection Error
error.description: Could not connect to the simulation server. Please try again later.
